endorsements.name: Hyunwoo Kim
endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Berlin 2025: Day One Results
endorsements.description: Hyunwoo Kim ( @V4bel ) and Wongi Lee ( @_qwerty_po ) of Theori were able to escalate to root on Red Hat Linux with an info leak and a UAF, but one of the bugs used was an N-day. They still win $15,000 and 1.5 Master of Pwn points.
